subs.text: Warning. The Warden approaches. This is it, Pilot. Everything we trained for.
Remember the briefing.
The Warden.
STOP! Stop right there! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a scout?!
That is not the voice from the briefing.
Every cycle they send another one! Shiny ship! Big gun! NO MANNERS!
I am the Warden! I keep these lanes! And I am SO TIRED of saying that!
Turn around. Go home. With that gun, the lanes stay closed!
Proceed with the engagement, Pilot.
Statements by the Warden are not covered by your contract.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
My POD! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a pod?!
Scouts, to me! No, not AT him, AROUND him! Protect the lane!
Your first live lock! Intel filed. Every scan helps the Authority map its lanes.
I am NOT tired! I am pacing myself for the next three hundred years!
A disarm. That is forty percent.
I am sure you had a reason, and I am sure it was a good one.
Fine! FINE! Everything I have! EVERYTHING!
Three hundred years, and you all bring the same gun!
Oh. Oh, there goes another ring. Count them, zero one two two.
Count what they put where the rings were.
